entities.summary: Guido III da Polenta was a member of the da Polenta family and a lord of Ravenna, Italy during the Medieval period. He played a significant role in the history of Ravenna, serving as a key figure in the city's governance and contributing to its cultural and political development. His legacy can be seen in the city's architecture and art, with many of his family members leaving lasting marks on the city's landscape. Guido III da Polenta's life was marked by his involvement in the governance of Ravenna, including his role in the city's relations with neighboring territories. He was a key figure in the city's economic and cultural growth, with his family's influence extending to the region's politics and society. Guido III da Polenta's life and legacy are a testament to the enduring impact of the da Polenta family on Ravenna's history and culture.
